name: AI token usage
question: Is AI use still growing?
metric: Tokens used through OpenRouter, latest full month
solvedIf: AI handles a large share of software work
trendLabel: Tokens used through OpenRouter per month, in trillions.
caution: This covers one service, not all AI. Part of this growth is OpenRouter itself becoming popular, and big companies mostly buy from AI labs directly.
Tokens are not all software work, and cheap or free models can raise the count without much more being built. Newer models also use more tokens for the same task.
rule: Growing when more tokens are used than in the same month a year before.

analysis.title: Most used models
analysis.intro: No single model dominates. These are the top five of 2026-10.

scoreReason: 353 times the tokens of January 2025, against a goal of 1,000 times.
